core.text: Propose moving receipt-selection control from routine bulk use of the pending display into a manual clock-and-ledger protocol carried by R6, with FIFO commitments carried by R5. The dashboard remains the request eligibility gate. This grants no automation, filtering feature, or extra capacity.

Registration clerk validates N3,N4,N5,N6,N7,N8 at ticks 0,1,2,3,4,5 respectively. Dispatcher requests individual N2,N3,N4 at ticks 0,1,2; idles at 3; bulk at 4; individual N7 at 5 and N8 at 6. Predicted bulk membership is N5,N6. Predicted deliveries are N2,N3,N4 at 1,2,3 and N5,N6,N7,N8 at 5,6,7,8. Six actions; eight registrations by boundary 6 and eight recognitions by boundary 9, including initial N1. This is a proposed trace, not an observed execution.

Closest rival uses the same trace but substitutes bulk at tick 0. Replay both finite traces using boundary ledgers. Rival prediction: initial N1 duplicate shifts N4 delivery to tick 4, so bulk at 4 repeats N4; N8 then falls beyond the horizon. Migration defeat: any prohibited request, more than six actions, fewer than eight registrations or recognitions, or predicted queue membership disagreement.

residue.text: Distinct operation: retain a boundary burden ledger joining registration completion, chosen request, action total, enqueued IDs, eligibility, processed ID, and recognition/display mismatch. Budget predicts six clerk validations, six dispatcher choices, seven server entries, zero duplicates or failures, and one idle eligible-delivery slot at tick 4. Ledger readings add no stipulated clerk labor; protocol adherence and selecting identities remain dispatcher responsibilities.

Fresh stage2 must independently attack dependence on accurate boundary interpretation and FIFO commitments. Hypotheses include mistaken bulk membership or late N8 placement; neither is established, and no final attack is selected. No dashboard repair, added staff, or alternate channel is available. Delay origin, later sender adaptation, empirical performance, and global schedule optimality remain unknown.

tension.account_a: The proposed ledger-and-queue carrier can control distinct receipt delivery within the fixed budget.
tension.account_b: Tentative challenger: the new carrier remains governed by stale pending selection and cannot avoid duplicate queue occupation.
tension.prediction_a: A compliant replay yields zero duplicates and eight distinct recognitions by boundary 9.
tension.prediction_b: The same compliant replay necessarily exposes a duplicate and fewer than eight recognitions; M3 and M2 separate these incompatible claims.
